description: Responsive image map: children define percentage-coordinate hotspots (rect, circle, poly) over a child , with an SVG hit-testing overlay, keyboard-focusable anchors, and rich HTML tooltips. Without JS the image renders and each map-area shows as a labeled list item.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Image URL used to create the when no child is authored.

attributes.name: data-label-map
attributes.description: Group name fallback when there is no aria-label/aria-labelledby and the image has no alt.

events.name: image-map:area-enter
events.description: Pointer entered or focus moved onto an area; area is the <map-area> element.

events.name: image-map:area-leave
events.description: Pointer left or focus moved off an area.

events.name: image-map:area-activate
events.description: Area clicked, tapped, or activated with Enter/Space. Cancelable: preventDefault() stops link navigation.

events.name: image-map:regions-changed
events.description: Fired after the regions setter rebuilds the map.

properties.name: regions
properties.type: Array<{ shape, coords, label?, href?, target?, tooltip?, disabled?, content? }>
properties.description: Get the regions from the <map-area> children (content is a string for text-only areas or a cloned DocumentFragment for markup) or assign to rebuild them. String content renders as text, never HTML; pass a Node, DocumentFragment or <template> for rich tooltips. Fires image-map:regions-changed with source 'property'.

childAttributes.name: coords
childAttributes.description: Percentage coordinates (0-100), space or comma separated: rect x1 y1 x2 y2, circle cx cy r, poly x1 y1 x2 y2 ...

childAttributes.name: label
childAttributes.description: Accessible name of the hotspot; falls back to the area's text content. Shown as the list label without JS.

childAttributes.name: href
childAttributes.description: Navigation target; the hotspot becomes an <a> focus anchor. Not a link without JS: also author an <a href> in the content for no-JS reachability.

childAttributes.name: tooltip
childAttributes.description: Tooltip mode: hover (default; on hover/focus, hoverable), click (toggle on click/Enter/Space, focus moves into interactive content, Escape returns), none.

childAttributes.name: disabled
childAttributes.description: Removes the hotspot from interaction and the tab order.

structure.description: Direct child image the overlay is laid over (or use src/alt on the host).
Hotspot definition; its child content becomes the tooltip (and the no-JS list item body).
